      <!-- Main Description -->
      <section class="talk-description">
        Artificial intelligence is reshaping how we think about software, data analysis, and the relationship between developers and users. In this conversation hosted by Dr. Cynthia Huang with Dr. Hadley Wickham and Assoc. Prof. Damjan Vukcevic, we explore what AI means for data-driven work, how it may change the way we build and use tools, and what it asks of us as mentors, leaders, and collaborators in data and development.
      </section>

His work includes packages for data science (like the tidyverse, which includes ggplot2, dplyr, and tidyr) and principled software development (e.g. roxygen2, testthat, and pkgdown).
